name: com.gameframex.unity.scene
description:
GameFrameX Scene — Unity scene management package built on YooAsset. Loads scenes asynchronously returning Task<SceneHandle> with additive mode support, unloads scenes, tracks loaded / loading / unloading states, orders the active scene through scene priorities, and refreshes the main camera reference, with load success / update (duration) / failure and unload events dispatched through the event bus. Startup moves to code-level SceneOptions (GameFrameXOptions.Configure: load-update and dependency-asset event toggles). Docs: https://gameframex.doc.alianblank.com

GameFrameX Scene — 基于 YooAsset 的 Unity 场景管理功能包。异步加载场景返回 Task<SceneHandle>（支持叠加模式）、卸载场景、跟踪已加载/加载中/卸载中状态、按场景优先级排序活跃场景并刷新主相机引用；加载成功/更新（耗时）/失败与卸载事件均经事件总线分发。启动配置收敛为代码级 SceneOptions（GameFrameXOptions.Configure：加载更新与依赖资源事件开关）。文档：https://gameframex.doc.alianblank.com
